# AssetCategories

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Core.Editors.SceneBuilding` · assembly `VRFramework.Core.Editors` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Editor/SceneBuilder/AssetSources/IAssetSource.cs#L20)

The kinds of asset the Assets category deals in - what an entry *is*, shown on the
card and offered as the type filter. Kept to the things a scene is actually built out of:
something you place, something you hear, something you dress a surface with. Shaders,
animation clips, scripts and the like are authoring inputs, not scene content, so the
browser does not list them.
Sources are free to use their own [`Category`](/api/vrframework-core-editors-scenebuilding/AssetEntry#category) values for finer
grouping ("Furniture", "Tools"); these are the names the built-in source and the icon
lookup agree on.
